exercise.name: Prayer Push

reference.title: Prayer Push
reference.listing: Page could not be read (gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy). Online descriptions of a "prayer push" differ (a standing palm press versus a push-up with the hands in a prayer position); the standing palm press is authored here and the reading is flagged as uncertain.
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

exercise.mechanics: Compound (isometric palm squeeze with shoulder flexion and elbow extension)

breathing.pattern: Breathe out as you press the palms together and push them forward; breathe in as they come back to the chest. Do not hold your breath.
breathing.cadence: About 1.6 s out, 1 s squeeze, 1.6 s back

prescription.progression: Squeeze harder and hold longer; then a plate or ball squeeze press

cues.text: Stand tall, feet hip width; palms pressed together in front of the chest, fingers up, elbows out.
Breathe out, squeeze the palms together as hard as you can and push them straight forward.
Arms almost straight at chest height; keep squeezing, shoulders down.
Breathe in and draw the hands back to the chest without easing the squeeze.
Reset the posture and go again.

mistakes.fix: Keep the shoulders down away from the ears.

mistakes.mistake: Letting the squeeze go soft on the way back
mistakes.fix: Press the palms together through the whole rep.
Keep the wrists comfortable; ease off if they ache.

kinematics.norm: Palms pressed together throughout; the chest works isometrically (clinical opinion)
From well bent at the chest to almost straight at arm length (clinical opinion)
Arms move forward at about chest height (clinical opinion)
Slow push and return with a short squeeze (clinical opinion)

cautions: Wrists: pressing with the wrists bent back can strain them; keep the pressure comfortable (from the source description).
Stop if sharp pain, numbness or tingling occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Wrist discomfort: press with the fingers pointing forward instead of up.
regressions: Squeeze at the chest only (no push).
